scenario: The `default` dialect enables every form in the catalog per LFCA.8.1 — running as-is gives a full-surface engine. Pin: all major action forms compile cleanly under explicit `use default`.
rules_ds:
use default

service sensor.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call sensor.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 1_min
    cache key: "last" value: t.v
    cache_delete key: "old"
